newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares seen recovering after bourse drop.
newsitem.headline: German shares seen recovering after bourse drop.

text.p: German shares were expected to continue recovering in afternoon IBIS trading after declining 0.72 percent in Wednesday's bourse session, traders said.

The DAX index on Thursday should also resume its ascent toward the 2,900 point mark, barring a fall on Wall Street, they said. "I think we're going to go higher," said one trader in Frankfurt. "We're seeing new strength coming in the last hour, but keep your eye on the Dow."
The IBIS DAX was down 24.03 points at 2,876.73 by 1438 GMT, but above the bourse close of 2866.07 points.
